full_page.content:
Pg. 70. Newspaper copy of Poem, A. Little Talk With Jesus. Newspaper copy of a quotation by Bl. Bartholomew of Martyrs. "We easily lose peace of mind, because we make it depend, not on the testimony of a good conscience, but on the judgment of men.
Pg. 71. Handwritten copy of quotations.
"Hope though inferior to charity is superior to faith ..... Faith reveals God to us that we may turn to Him, but hope tends to unite us with Him, and charity actually effects this union, which is the supreme aim of all Christian life". Chief Sufferings (211) He that hath mercy on the poor lendeth to the Lord and He will repay him. (Prov. XIX 17.)
"He looketh upon the earth and maketh it tremble. He toucheth the mountains and they smoke"Ps III-32. "For woe is unto me if I preach not the gospel" (I Cor. IX 16).
Pg. 72. Handwritten copy of quotations from Scripture: At Death of a Holy Religious. Rom. XIII 12 The night is passed .... day at hand Ps. LXXXIX We have rejoiced according to former affliction
Poverty -e.g. Sr. Therese p. 116-17 Ps. 144 Gratitude-I will extoll Thee O God my King, and will bless Thy name for ever, yea for ever and ever ......
The Lord is gracious and merciful ... The Lord is sweet to all; and His tender mercies are over all his works.
Pg. 73 Handwritten copy of quotations from Scripture:
"Ego sum quod hic fuit, quod hic est ego ego" Nov. 26 S. Sylvester. Ps. 36 (III 6) Vidi impium elevatum et super-exaltatum sicut cedros Sibani. El .....
Pgs. 74-77. Blank
Pg. 78 Handwritten two names.
Cover. Newspaper copy of Irish Poem.
